mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, as measured by the absolute level of PAYEMS (thousands of persons), is always associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, based on historical correlation exceeding 0.3 in the 2005-2024 dataset.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical correlation between PAYEMS level and 20d SPX returns > 0.3
failure_condition: The historical correlation between PAYEMS level and 20d SPX returns is negative or insignificant (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, the 5d forward returns are negative or insignificant (p>0.05) in a walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between monetary policy and inflation: when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL is above 275, it indicates a 'growth at risk' scenario where equity valuations face pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 275, the 60d forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession regime (defined by quarterly GDP growth rate < 0% as measured by GDPC1), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and risk aversion.
evidence_refs: fact:2021-04 data shows GDPC1=21440.929 (Q2 2021) > 19360.6 (Q1 2021) -> growth positive
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate < 0%, the 20d forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index exceeds 275, it indicates high inflation that triggers central bank tightening and equity market volatility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 275, the 5d forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST): when INDPRO is rising (month-over-month change > 0) and HOUST is above 1600, it indicates a strong economy with robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2021-08 data: INDPRO=100.0437 (revised from 101.5949) -> change negative
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where INDPRO month-over-month change > 0 AND HOUST > 1600, the 60d forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising by more than 0.3% in the last 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
evidence_refs: fact:2021-08 data: FEDFUNDS=0.09% (no change from previous month)
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS 3-month change > 0.3%, the 20d forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1600, the 5d forward returns are negative.
